fields.description:
## Problem

`rebar fsck` reports 8 stray top-level directories in the tickets tracker
(`/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker`), each flagged twice — once as
`MISSING_CREATE` (no CREATE event found) and once inside the single
`FOREIGN_STORE_PATH` finding:

    0efe-9207-2706-43a3  2021-2ef0-e36f-44fc  6f8a-45e5-d9ec-402c  a109-e758-71bb-4371
    afe5-db0b-e9c5-45d8  c827-81ee-a592-4d27  d052-ad3f-23c1-4511  fa38-670c-d8fc-4c22

Baseline: `fsck complete: 16 issues found` = 8 MISSING_CREATE + 6 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED
+ 1 FOREIGN_STORE_PATH + 1 ENV_ID_MISMATCH.

## Evidence (pre-removal triage)

All 8 are empty directories (`ls -laR` -> empty), none is committed
(`git ls-tree HEAD <dir>` empty for all 8), `git status --porcelain` in the tracker is
clean because git does not track empty directories, and `rebar exists <id>` returns
exit 1 for all 8. `lsof +D` on the tracker shows no process holding a file under any of
the 8. Directory mtimes span 2026-08-10 11:05 to 2026-08-12 12:52 — all far outside the
~30-minute live-writer window (triage run 2026-08-12 17:59 PDT).
`rebar tracker-maintenance --status` independently reports `unpushed ticket commits: 0`
and exactly these 8 as `foreign top-level paths`, so `--clean` covers them and the
break-glass `--force` is NOT needed. `rebar review-plan` itself logs each one as
"debris of an interrupted write; safe to delete".

## Likely cause

`os.makedirs(ticket_dir)` succeeded and the process died before the first event was
atomically renamed in — agents interrupted mid-write by host sleeps, session-limit
kills, and shell-cap timeouts across the active fleet.

## Relationship to 043f-3336-d5de-45be (closed)

That bug made the plan-relation reducer TOLERATE event-less directories, and explicitly
decided against writer-side cleanup because an automatic rmdir races a concurrent
session's in-flight write ("tolerate, never tidy"). This ticket does not reintroduce
automatic cleanup: it is a one-off operator-initiated sweep whose four guards
(empty, uncommitted, non-existent, no open handle, plus an mtime age check) are exactly
what an automatic writer-side rmdir could not establish.

## Plan (minimal, deterministic — four-guard discipline)

Guard 1 dir is empty; Guard 2 dir is uncommitted; Guard 3 `rebar exists <id>` exits 1;
Guard 4 no open file handle under it (`lsof +D`), corroborated by an mtime older than
30 minutes. Only directories passing all four are removed, via the sanctioned door
`rebar tracker-maintenance --clean` (backup ref before first write, refusal on unpushed
ticket commits, durable audit). No raw git in the tracker, no stash. `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED`
(benign, auto-resolved) and `ENV_ID_MISMATCH` (known by-design flag from change 1638)
are out of scope and must not be touched.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1: A per-directory triage verdict for all 8 directories is recorded as a comment on
      this ticket, each citing the four guards. Verified by `rebar show 7c6e-4b8a-59c5-46db`
      showing a comment naming all 8 ids with a verdict each.
- [ ] AC2: Every confirmed-debris directory is removed through
      `rebar tracker-maintenance --clean` (exit 0), and any directory failing a guard is
      excluded with its reason recorded. Verified by the command's own exit code and its
      printed backup ref.
- [ ] AC3: Post-sweep `rebar fsck` reports zero `MISSING_CREATE` and zero
      `FOREIGN_STORE_PATH` findings. Verified by
      `rebar fsck 2>&1 | grep -c -E 'MISSING_CREATE|FOREIGN_STORE_PATH'` returning 0.
- [ ] AC4: No committed ticket data is modified. Verified by capturing
      `git -C .tickets-tracker rev-parse HEAD` before and after and asserting the two are
      byte-identical, and by `git -C .tickets-tracker status --porcelain` staying clean.

## Testing

This is a store data operation, so verification is by command exit code and before/after
diff rather than by unit test:

1. Before: `rebar fsck 2>&1 | tail -1` (record the issue count) and
   `git -C /Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker rev-parse HEAD` (record the sha).
2. Guarded triage per directory: `ls -A <dir>` empty, `git ls-tree HEAD <dir>` empty,
   `rebar exists <id>` exit 1, `lsof +D` naming no file under it.
3. Act: `rebar tracker-maintenance --clean` — must exit 0 and print a backup ref.
4. After: `rebar fsck 2>&1 | grep -c -E 'MISSING_CREATE|FOREIGN_STORE_PATH'` must print 0;
   `git -C .tickets-tracker rev-parse HEAD` must equal the sha recorded in step 1;
   `git -C .tickets-tracker status --porcelain` must be empty.
